annotations.title: Look up many companies by CUI

description: Look up many Romanian companies by CUI in one call (up to 100): one result per input, in input order, each with found true/false and the company record. Each row counts as one lookup; a batch larger than what is left today is refused whole. fields or compact trims each record.

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

cuis.description: Up to 100 CUIs, as a list or one comma-separated string ('RO', spaces and leading zeros accepted, as in lookup_business).
cuis.title: Cuis

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

name: lookup_companies

outputSchema.description: One result per input CUI, in input order.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

errors.description: Rows that are input errors (empty, not a CUI, wrong control digit).

fields.description: The company fields kept when fields or compact trimmed the rows.

metering.description: What the batch cost: rows, counted, notCounted (input-error rows are not counted) and the rule.

notFound.description: Well-formed CUIs not in the snapshot.

results.description: Per input: input, cui, found, and company (the record) or error/reason.

company.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address, county, city, website, phone, caenActivities [{code, activity (RO), activityEn}], directors, representatives [{name, role}], status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, url (the firm's public record page to share with the user; null for sole traders and other natural persons), and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys (compact keeps url).

found.description: Whether a firm has this CUI.

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

title: Look up many companies by CUI
